decisions.statement: One reading of a seat's transcript answers the live-shell component.
One scan of the message store answers the send-in-flight component for every seat at once.
A live background command is a component apart from a live subagent.
A seat a subagent page names as its principal has a live subagent.
A seat no subagent page names has no live subagent.
Every page the index files answers for the seat that page names.
One read of the index answers the live-subagent component for every seat at once.
A page stating an agent id with no seat before the mark names no seat.

definition: the file-backed pending components of every seat, read in one pass over the fleet
